description: Mirror a Markdown checklist in this project (e.g. CHECKLIST.md) into the work graph. Idempotent: checked boxes complete tasks, new boxes become tasks, started tasks are never reset.

file.description: Path relative to the project root

label.description: Prefix for this file's milestones, e.g. "IDE" → "IDE · 1. Parser"

section.description: Only sync items under this heading (e.g. "29")

name: inventor_sync_checklist
